About the Computer Basic (MS Office) Course

A comprehensive digital literacy course designed for complete beginners and office job aspirants. Covers computer hardware basics, operating system navigation, document creation in MS Word, spreadsheets and formulas in MS Excel, presentations in PowerPoint, and safe internet browsing and email usage.

What You Will Learn

  • Computer fundamentals, file management and Windows operating system
  • MS Word: Letter typing, formatting, tables, and mail merge
  • MS Excel: Formulas, calculation sheets, charts, and data sorting
  • MS PowerPoint: Slide creation, formatting, and presentation tools
  • Internet search, Google Drive, email etiquette and cyber safety

Jobs After This Course

  • Office assistant
  • Computer operator
  • Foundation for Tally and DTP courses

Frequently Asked Questions

Who can join the Computer Basic (MS Office) course?

Open to all learners desiring digital literacy.

How long is the Computer Basic (MS Office) course?

3-4 Months (Dedicated PC Workstation for every student). Classes are hands-on, with most of the time spent practising in the lab.

What is the fee for the Computer Basic (MS Office) course?

The fee is subsidized. Asha Jyothi is a non-profit training centre, so fees are kept low for every student. Call your nearest campus for the current fee and batch timings.

What jobs can I get after the Computer Basic (MS Office) course?

Office assistant; Computer operator; Foundation for Tally and DTP courses.

Where can I join the Computer Basic (MS Office) course?

Asha Jyothi runs classes at three campuses: Alwal (Secunderabad, 80196 80291), Medchal (77803 46642) and Ramanthapur (99498 09263). Call the campus nearest you to check when the next batch starts.
